meta.source: Bangchak retail oil-price API (www.bangchak.co.th/api/oilprice) — daily Bangkok reference prices; free, no key, cloud-reachable (EPPO/PTT/data.go.th are geoblocked).
meta.label: MEASURED — live Thai retail fuel prices (฿/litre, Bangkok reference)
meta.note: The API pre-announces tomorrow's price; delta_tomorrow is a forward signal. No in-API history (YoY unavailable); daily snapshots build the series over time. Diesel = pickup/farm borrowers; gasohol = motorcycle borrowers. No LPG/NGV (Bangchak doesn't retail them; those need the geoblocked EPPO pull).
